name: proto
description: Proto makes prototypes from your product's own code. This plugin runs on your laptop and is driven by your coding agent: it connects your account, imports your product's design system, builds prototypes, serves them at public addresses, and listens for work sent from the Proto site.

app_url.title: Proto app URL
app_url.description: Your Proto app's address, for example https://<your proto domain>. It is shown in the setup prompt you copy from the site.

provision_secret.title: Provisioning secret
provision_secret.description: The provisioning secret shown in the setup prompt you copy from the site.
